product_one_liner.value: Syren provides enterprise data-engineering, supply-chain optimization, and AI solutions that help organizations modernize data platforms and operationalize AI.
product_one_liner.notes: Syren describes itself as a data engineering and supply-chain solutions company and an enterprise Data & AI adoption partner.

pricing_page.notes: The public homepage/footer has no pricing link or public pricing page; the contact page directs visitors to discuss goals with a solutions expert.

named_customers.notes: Syren’s compliance profile identifies these organizations among the clients it serves.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists the company-size band as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company’s legal page names Bellevue, Washington, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Syren’s legal/about statement says it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes multiple posts detailing product builds and architecture; technical authors include Syren solution architects. The posts are technical rather than merely marketing, though author roles are described as architect rather than uniformly titled engineer.

public_docs.notes: No product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link appears in the public site footer; targeted searches did not surface a public docs portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Syren’s careers portal has a full-time AI Engineer + Knowledge Graph/Ontology posting.

model_provider.value: Syren names Databricks Foundation Models and Model Serving for its Pricing Agent; a separate GenAI control-tower case study names LlamaAI and VannaAI.
model_provider.notes: These are model/platform tools named for specific implementations, not a claim that one provider powers all Syren products.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed on Syren’s compliance page; PCI DSS is not named there.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports that Syren has not raised any funding rounds; amount is zero and date is blank as the neutral schema values for no round.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no rounds, so there was no funding raise in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current Syren listing is for a full-time Sales Development Representative and includes an Apply option.

launched_6mo.notes: Syren published its Sales Journey AI field-planning product post on 2026-06-09, within the six-month window ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Syren announced Vibhu Tiwari as Vice President, GTM & Channels on 2025-11-11, inside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting lists these as sales and prospecting platforms candidates should know; it does not independently prove internal deployment.
